reply_text:
Sofia, I can't find a named night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor in anything you can see. I checked #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops, our DM and the shared files.

The Coastal cheat sheet does mention Driftmoor Marine Freight. It says engineering gave "the night dispatcher" a manual CSV patch for the failed tide-table import on Terminal B. It doesn't say who that person is or give an email address, and I haven't guessed one.

Kwame is the best person to ask for the name and address.

Driftmoor is outside pemberline.com. Any mail to them, even a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. Once you have the contact, tell me and I'll ask Ruth for you.
